en: Of all the lodges that make up the Guild, the Grand Lodge is the most important.{wait}{clear}The current Grand Master was Grandpa's best friend.{wait}{clear}Maybe I'll go see him...{wait}{clear}
Yes, since we're here, why not go and see? You might hear something new.{wait}{clear}
Yes, it's where the Grand Master resides.{wait}{clear}I came here once with the hero Fein. I met the Grand Master then, too.{wait}{clear}
Fein? Really?{wait}{clear}
Yes, he's been doing very well as a hero.{wait}{clear}
This Fein... he's tall, with silver hair... a man, right...?{wait}{clear}
Yes, that's right... Do you know him, Irene?{wait}{clear}
Y-yeah... sort of...{wait}{clear}
Grandpa and the Grand Master were best friends, so I thought I'd drop by... but I'll do it another time.{wait}{clear}I might just be a bother...{wait}{clear}
Are you sure? Since we're here, why not stop by?{wait}{clear}
I said it's fine. I'll do it another time.{wait}{clear}Come on, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, let's hurry on.{wait}{clear}
Y-yes...{wait}{clear}
We ended up here again, huh... Maybe this time I'll go see the Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
Since we're here, why not do that?{wait}{clear}
Yeah... I guess so...{wait}{clear}
Come with me, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I'm kinda nervous.{wait}{clear}
You're coming too, right, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
Yes, if that's all right with you, Irene...{wait}{clear}
What are you talking about? Even if I said no, you'd just follow me in secret, right?{wait}{clear}
Huh? Well... I suppose so...{wait}{clear}
You really can't lie, can you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Okay, let's go see the Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
Grand Master, forgive me for calling on you so suddenly. My name is...{wait}{clear}
Master
Zig's granddaughter...?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I'm Irene.{wait}{clear}
Irene, I'm glad to meet you.{wait}{clear}
Thank you. It's an honor to meet you too, Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
Now, now, no need to be so formal. Still, the way your power rises around you is just like Zig's.{wait}{clear}
Is... is it?{wait}{clear}
Yes... And your power is considerably stronger... No one in the Guild on the continent has an ability like this.{wait}{clear}
Oh no... I'm still nowhere near my grandfather...{wait}{clear}
In skill, perhaps. But the magical power a sorcerer is born with does not change over a lifetime.{wait}{clear}It seems Zig left behind a wonderful talent.{wait}{clear}
Thank you very much, Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
Now, Irene, you came all this way. Surely there's something you wish to talk about?{wait}{clear}
Yes... there is... There's something I'd like to ask you, Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
What is it?{wait}{clear}
Um... do you know anything about Fein and my sister?{wait}{clear}
Fein... What happened to him is a terrible shame...{wait}{clear}If I had tried harder to stop him, it would never have come to that...{wait}{clear}
Did something happen to Fein?{wait}{clear}
You didn't know?{wait}{clear}On his way to the Empire in pursuit of Serenis, he was attacked by someone and lost his life...{wait}{clear}
No...! Is that true?!{wait}{clear}
Yes... The Guild has confirmed it.{wait}{clear}
Fein... no... I can't believe it...{wait}{clear}
He was a fine man who carried on Zig's wishes.{wait}{clear}He served this Guild well as a Warlock, too...{wait}{clear}For him to meet such an end... no one regrets it more than I...{wait}{clear}
Why? How could that happen?{wait}{clear}
It pains me greatly to tell this to you, Zig's granddaughter... but it must be said.{wait}{clear}
Grand Master? What do you...{wait}{clear}
...It may be that Serenis... had Fein killed...{wait}{clear}
No... that's a lie...{wait}{clear}

Rumors have reached us that Serenis crossed to the Empire and is scheming behind the scenes at court.{wait}{clear}And if the secret art that caused that tragedy is real, she can no longer be in her right mind.{wait}{clear}Nothing would be surprising now. What she does is no longer the work of a human...{wait}{clear}
...I can't believe it.{wait}{clear}Sis, killing Fein with her own hands... No matter what happened... she'd never...{wait}{clear}

I don't want to believe it either... Irene... I understand how painful this is for you.{wait}{clear}It's true that what we hear of Serenis is only rumor. There is no proof at all that Serenis killed Fein...{wait}{clear}But if it turns out to be true... painful as it is, you will have to accept it.{wait}{clear}However cruel it may be, if it is the truth, it must be accepted...{wait}{clear}

If what they say of Serenis is true, then you may be the only one who can end this tragedy...{wait}{clear}My dear friend, his apprentice, his granddaughter... all dead. I could not bear to lose you too, the last one he left behind.{wait}{clear}
Grand Master...{wait}{clear}But nothing is certain yet, is it? Then... I'll...{wait}{clear}
Don't do anything reckless, Irene.{wait}{clear}
I know... I only want to know the truth. Excuse me.{wait}{clear}
...Fein... I can't believe it...{wait}{clear}
Irene... um...{wait}{clear}
Sorry... ＄＄＄＄＄＄... To think all this happened while I was shut away in the tower...{wait}{clear}
Um... I'm truly sorry to ask at a time like this...{wait}{clear}but would you tell me about Fein and this Serenis?{wait}{clear}
Okay...{wait}{clear}Fein is... my brother-in-law... He married my sister Serenis... and yet... Sis did that to Fein...{wait}{clear}I absolutely can't believe it...{wait}{clear}
Please cheer up.{n}
We don't know the truth yet...{n}

Please cheer up, Irene. I understand how painful this is for you.{wait}{clear}But we don't know yet whether any of it is true, do we?{wait}{clear}Then let's find out together. I will help you however I can.{wait}{clear}

Irene, pull yourself together. We still don't know what the truth is, do we? Shouldn't finding it out come first?{wait}{clear}I understand how painful this is for you. But if you stop here, you'll never learn anything.{wait}{clear}I will help you however I can. So please, cheer up.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... thank you...{wait}{clear}You're right... I have to find out... I have to see Sis...{wait}{clear}Let's go, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Let's find out what's really true.{wait}{clear}
Since we're here, why not do that?{wait}{clear}
So it's about Fein and Serenis, as I thought...{wait}{clear}Fein is still traveling. Only very rarely, but he does show his face here.{wait}{clear}
I see... he's still traveling... And about my sister, is there anything...{wait}{clear}
Serenis... It's nothing certain, but I've heard she is in the Grosain Empire.{wait}{clear}
In the Empire? And does Fein know that?{wait}{clear}
No, I didn't hear it from him. A man who came from the north told the tale recently.{wait}{clear}
Sis... in the Empire... why...{wait}{clear}

Irene... Fein told me what happened in that tragedy...{wait}{clear}What befell Serenis and Zig was a great shame... But if what he said of the secret art is true, Serenis will never regain her sanity.{wait}{clear}
No... But then, Fein...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... but that is the nature of that secret art...{wait}{clear}Yet Fein refuses to understand it... No, even if he knows, his heart won't allow it.{wait}{clear}
Fein feels responsible for my sister... He thinks it's his fault she became like that...{wait}{clear}

I suppose so...{wait}{clear}That man struggles and suffers... He can neither forget nor give up.{wait}{clear}Irene, you are what my dear friend Zig left behind. And Fein is a precious comrade to the Guild...{wait}{clear}I do not wish this tragedy to grow any further... At times, a cruel choice is necessary...{wait}{clear}Forgive me, Irene... This is all the advice an old man like me can offer...{wait}{clear}
...You have a guardian, don't you?{wait}{clear}A strange sensation... one I have never felt before...{wait}{clear}Are you aware of it?{wait}{clear}
I see... Then let us pray it is a guardian who brings good fortune.{wait}{clear}Irene, come again anytime.{wait}{clear}
Yes... Grand Master.{wait}{clear}
...It seems you have a guardian as well.{wait}{clear}
I felt it when Fein came here too... A strange sensation... Let us hope it grants you both some good fortune.{wait}{clear}Irene, come again anytime.{wait}{clear}
Fein...{wait}{clear}.........{wait}{clear}
Um, Irene...{wait}{clear}It seems there's a lot going on, but if you don't mind, would you tell me whatever you feel you can?{wait}{clear}
